entries.note: Hydroponic shed sunk into the ground: a low roof ridge with two amber grow-light skylights above grade, earth banked up all four sides (owner: "embed them into the earth"). The bank is shading only, so it takes the planet's ground. Walkable earth mound: light cover, half height 0.18; vehicles pass.
The sunken shed half as long, to end a row or fill a short plot. Walkable earth mound: light cover, half height 0.18.
Pump house: water and nutrient tanks, pump and header pipe on a skid, ending a shed row.

note: The covered farm on hostile worlds (story-map-pools.md, Planet skin; PlanetSkin.SHED), picked by the owner over domes and glass halls after the polytunnels did not read as hydroponics. Measured 1448x1086 RGBA, three alpha pieces. Geometry-first reskin of templates/hydro-sheds-guide.png (hydroponics-guide.py, 160 px a cell); ImageGen returned the sheet uniformly at 0.943 of the guide and every piece within a few pixels of its guide, so each rect is its guide frame at that scale. The sheet exported is hydro-sheds-embedded.png: the raw regraded to warm amber grow-light by grow-light-amber.py (owner picked amber), then each shed sunk into an earth bank by hydro-sheds-embedded.py (owner: "embed them into the earth"). Exact prompt in hydro-sheds.prompt.txt.
